title: fisc page config
description: window.FISC_CONFIG: what site/app.js has before it fetches anything, rendered into the page's own <script>. Every object is closed, so an unknown field is refused at the export.

schema_version.description: The projection's own version, which site/app.js compares against its SCHEMA_VERSION before it draws.

exported_by.description: The export that wrote this page. Every artifact it links carries the same string as generated_by, and the client refuses a pair that disagree.

primary.description: The projection this page is of.

items.description: One published year with its words, built by the packager so the client never composes a figure or a caveat.

year.description: An integer with no floor: which fiscal years exist is data/sources.yaml's to say.

path.description: The column file this year is fetched from.

hero.description: One headline figure, already formatted by the packager, so the server-rendered tile and the one a year switch paints cannot disagree.

kind.description: Which tile this is, so the page can style a hero differently from the rest without reading its position.

items.description: One headline figure, already formatted by the packager, so the server-rendered tile and the one a year switch paints cannot disagree.

kind.description: Which tile this is, so the page can style a hero differently from the rest without reading its position.

items.description: What a chart page is given about a caveat: its line and the link to its paragraph. NO `text`: the paragraph lives on the caveats page.

counts.description: What the year's document holds, for the counts sentence.

items.description: What one of this year's rungs draws, one entry per declared step.
What a chart page is given about a caveat: its line and the link to its paragraph. NO `text`: the paragraph lives on the caveats page.

lede.description: The year and basis as the lede names them; the template renders it and the client repaints it and names a column by it.

docs.description: Cited documents by doc_id, keyed by data and not enumerated: which documents a page cites is the corpus's to say.

additionalProperties.description: One cited document: its title, and for every page the site cites, the links a citation opens, built by the export so the client composes none.

pages.description: Page number to its links. An empty link is one this export has nothing to point at: no PDF URL for the document, or no records published.

pdf.description: The city's own PDF, opened at the page.

text.description: The committed page text; relative to the site, or absolute under --source-browse-url.

records.description: The page's fact-store shard, relative to the site.

overview.description: The page's own chart: its form and that form's hints. An overview keeps no flank, widens nothing and caps nothing, because no node has opened.

allOf.description: A chart of form sankey carries its sankey hints, and no other form does.

steps.description: How the page opens a node. OMITTED, NEVER [], WHEN ABSENT: app.js then isolates on a click.

items.description: How the page opens a node, one hop per step.

allOf.description: A chart of form sankey carries its sankey hints, and no other form does.
A step's Sankey names the tiers it draws once a node has opened.

key.description: What other steps name this one by.

after.description: The keys of the steps whose charts this one opens from. A root carries "" in the list, not an empty list.

role.description: Which nodes at `from` open, by node.role; absent opens every node at the tier.

projection.description: The schedule this step draws, selected out of the year's own column; absent means the same document as the step before it.

form.description: Which renderer draws the chart once a node has opened; enums.schema.json chart_form.

sankey.description: The Sankey form's hints, present exactly when form is sankey; a step's names its tiers.

residual.description: Endpoints of the chart this step opens FROM whose flow the document it draws does not decompose, id to declared reason.

residual_grain.description: The grain the document this step draws does NOT split the residual's money by, in the city's singular word; the client names the residual mark for it.

gaps.description: Nodes this step OPENS whose total the document it draws does not reach, id to the licences for each column it differs in: the signed cents the chart above carries over what the drawn document accounts for, and why. The client holds the difference its drawn chart comes to against the licence for its column and refuses any other.

cents.description: Signed: positive where the chart above puts more through the node than the drawn document accounts for. Never zero: a licence for a node that balances is refused at the write.

kind_labels.description: Each link kind in the page's words; project.LinkKindLabel.

wording.description: Every sentence app.js composes about the chart on screen, as templates it fills. `{name}` is a variable's value and `{name:one|many}` is the value followed by the singular or the plural word, by whether the value is 1.

counts.description: The counts line over a chart drawn whole: {links}, {nodes}, {facts}.

counts_partial.description: The counts line over a chart that draws some of its document's facts: {links}, {nodes}, {cited}, {facts}.

counts_carried.description: The counts line over a chart carrying ribbons from the chart above: {links}, {nodes}, {own}, {cited}, {facts}, {carried}.

counts_carried_from.description: Appended to counts_carried when every carried ribbon came from one document: {above}, {theirs}.

opened_hint.description: The chart hint's opening sentence on a rung: {label}.

open_further.description: The hint on a rung whose nodes open: {where}, which is in_column or empty.

open_into.description: The hint on an overview whose nodes open: {where}.

nothing_further.description: The hint on a rung nothing opens from.

nothing_opens.description: The hint on an overview nothing opens from.

follow.description: The hint's sentence about the isolating gesture.

expand.description: The hint's sentence about a folded tail, where the chart draws one.

swatch.description: The hint's sentence about the legend, where the overview draws one.

in_column.description: The clause naming the openable columns: {columns}, already joined.

column_left.description: The leftmost column's name in that clause.

column_middle.description: The middle column's name, on a chart of three.

column_second.description: The second column's name, on a chart of more than three.

column_third.description: The third column's name, on a chart of more than three.

go_back.description: The description's sentence about the way back from a rung.

back_control.description: A breadcrumb control's text: {back}, the step's back.

sankey_hints.description: What the Sankey form may fold and where, which the client's capColumn and foldDocument spend.

tiers.description: The tier set drawn, left to right: a column order and not only a set. Absent on the overview draws the document whole.

keep.description: The flank of the chart on screen kept beside the opened node, nearest the centre first.

widen.description: The tiers added beyond the window's own three, in the order they are added; a narrow client drops them from the end.

items.description: How many marks one tier draws before the rest fold into a tail. THE PERMISSION, NOT THE FOLD: which members fold is the client's.

tail.description: The plural noun the folded tail is counted in; absent takes the step's own.

side.description: Which end of a link the opened node is; absent for the end links point at.
